title: Modern Gold Scattered Baguette Ring
storyHtml:
Baguette crystals set at playful, staggered angles along an open band — a little art-deco, a little firework. Architectural sparkle for the minimalist who likes a wink of drama.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Baguette-cut 5A clear zircon, staggered open band
